verdict.rationale: Meta documents downloading Llama weights through its own CLI (signed-URL request flow) and the official Hugging Face org once you accept the Llama Community License. The license is clearly stated in the canonical repo, with per-family license and use-policy files, and the docs describe running the weights yourself on desktop, llama.cpp and edge runtimes. Community comments that the license is not OSI open source and carries a 700M-MAU clause confirm the terms are stated rather than dispute the capability. Missing for 10: downloads are gated behind an approval step rather than open, and there is no hands-on corroboration of the download-and-run flow.
